005package org.wpilib.math.estimator;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
009import org.wpilib.math.kinematics.DifferentialDriveOdometry;
010import org.wpilib.math.kinematics.DifferentialDriveWheelPositions;
011import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
012import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
013import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N1;
014import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N3;
015
016/**
017 * This class wraps {@link DifferentialDriveOdometry Differential Drive Odometry} to fuse
018 * latency-compensated vision measurements with differential drive encoder measurements. It is
019 * intended to be a drop-in replacement for {@link DifferentialDriveOdometry}; in fact, if you never
020 * call {@link DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator#addVisionMeasurement} and only call {@link
021 * DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator#update} then this will behave exactly the same as
022 * DifferentialDriveOdometry.
023 *
024 * <p>{@link DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator#update} should be called every robot loop.
025 *
026 * <p>{@link DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator#addVisionMeasurement} can be called as infrequently as
027 * you want; if you never call it then this class will behave exactly like regular encoder odometry.
028 */
029public class DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator extends PoseEstimator<DifferentialDriveWheelPositions> {
030  /**
031   * Constructs a DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator with default standard deviations for the model and
032   * vision measurements.
033   *
034   * <p>The default standard deviations of the model states are 0.02 meters for x, 0.02 meters for
035   * y, and 0.01 radians for heading. The default standard deviations of the vision measurements are
036   * 0.1 meters for x, 0.1 meters for y, and 0.1 radians for heading.
037   *
038   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
039   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
040   * @param leftDistance The distance traveled by the left encoder in meters.
041   * @param rightDistance The distance traveled by the right encoder in meters.
042   * @param initialPose The starting pose estimate.
043   */
044  public DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator(
045      Rotation2d gyroAngle, double leftDistance, double rightDistance, Pose2d initialPose) {
046    this(
047        gyroAngle,
048        leftDistance,
049        rightDistance,
050        initialPose,
051        VecBuilder.fill(0.02, 0.02, 0.01),
052        VecBuilder.fill(0.1, 0.1, 0.1));
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator.
057   *
058   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
059   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
060   * @param leftDistance The distance traveled by the left encoder in meters.
061   * @param rightDistance The distance traveled by the right encoder in meters.
062   * @param initialPose The estimated initial pose.
063   * @param stateStdDevs Standard deviations of the pose estimate (x position in meters, y position
064   *     in meters, and heading in radians). Increase these numbers to trust your state estimate
065   *     less.
066   * @param visionMeasurementStdDevs Standard deviations of the vision pose measurement (x position
067   *     in meters, y position in meters, and heading in radians). Increase these numbers to trust
068   *     the vision pose measurement less.
069   */
070  public DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator(
071      Rotation2d gyroAngle,
072      double leftDistance,
073      double rightDistance,
074      Pose2d initialPose,
075      Matrix<N3, N1> stateStdDevs,
076      Matrix<N3, N1> visionMeasurementStdDevs) {
077    super(
078        new DifferentialDriveOdometry(gyroAngle, leftDistance, rightDistance, initialPose),
079        stateStdDevs,
080        visionMeasurementStdDevs);
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Resets the robot's position on the field.
085   *
086   * <p>The gyroscope angle does not need to be reset here on the user's robot code. The library
087   * automatically takes care of offsetting the gyro angle.
088   *
089   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
090   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
091   * @param leftPosition The distance traveled by the left encoder in meters.
092   * @param rightPosition The distance traveled by the right encoder in meters.
093   * @param pose The position on the field that your robot is at.
094   */
095  public void resetPosition(
096      Rotation2d gyroAngle, double leftPosition, double rightPosition, Pose2d pose) {
097    resetPosition(
098        gyroAngle, new DifferentialDriveWheelPositions(leftPosition, rightPosition), pose);
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Updates the pose estimator with wheel encoder and gyro information. This should be called every
103   * loop.
104   *
105   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
106   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
107   * @param distanceLeft The total distance travelled by the left wheel in meters.
108   * @param distanceRight The total distance travelled by the right wheel in meters.
109   * @return The estimated pose of the robot in meters.
110   */
111  public Pose2d update(Rotation2d gyroAngle, double distanceLeft, double distanceRight) {
112    return update(gyroAngle, new DifferentialDriveWheelPositions(distanceLeft, distanceRight));
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Updates the pose estimator with wheel encoder and gyro information. This should be called every
117   * loop.
118   *
119   * @param currentTime Time at which this method was called, in seconds.
120   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
121   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
122   * @param distanceLeft The total distance travelled by the left wheel in meters.
123   * @param distanceRight The total distance travelled by the right wheel in meters.
124   * @return The estimated pose of the robot in meters.
125   */
126  public Pose2d updateWithTime(
127      double currentTime, Rotation2d gyroAngle, double distanceLeft, double distanceRight) {
128    return updateWithTime(
129        currentTime, gyroAngle, new DifferentialDriveWheelPositions(distanceLeft, distanceRight));
130  }
131}
